#helper

```{r}
# ---------------- Helper utilities ----------------
chrnum <- function(idx, genome_build = "hg38"){
  if (genome_build %in% c("hg19","hg38")) {
    names <- c(as.character(1:22), "X", "Y")
  } else if (genome_build == "mm10") {
    names <- c(as.character(1:19), "X", "Y", "M")
  } else if (genome_build == "dm6") {
    names <- c("2L","2R","3L","3R","4","X","Y")
  } else stop("Unsupported genome_build")
  return(names[idx])
}

TIGER_last_autosome <- function(genome_build){
  if (genome_build == "mm10") return(19)
  if (genome_build == "dm6") return(5)
  return(22)
}
```

#step2 #---------------- Part 2: Import samtools-filtered start positions and produce Coordinates_to_remove ----------

```{r}
# Accept either per_chr_start_files (named list) OR a single file with two columns: chr pos
build_coordinates_to_remove <- function(chr_length,
                                        per_chr_start_files = NULL,
                                        single_positions_file = NULL,
                                        out_file = NULL,
                                        chr_col = 1, pos_col = 2,
                                        header = FALSE){
  # chr_length: named integer vector or named list with chromosome lengths, names = chromosome names
 
  # single_positions_file: single file path with two columns (chr,pos) for all chromosomes (new behaviour)
  # header: whether single_positions_file has header
  
  # prepare empty coordinates_to_remove list
  Coordinates_to_remove <- vector("list", length(chr_length))
  names(Coordinates_to_remove) <- names(chr_length)
  
  if (!is.null(single_positions_file)){
    if (!file.exists(single_positions_file)) stop("single_positions_file not found: ", single_positions_file)
    # read two-column file (flexible delim)
    # faster approach: read.table; for large files consider data.table::fread()
    df <- read.table(single_positions_file, header = header, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    if (ncol(df) < 2) stop("single_positions_file must have at least two columns: chr and pos")
    chr_vals <- as.character(df[[chr_col]])
    pos_vals <- as.integer(df[[pos_col]])
    # group by chromosome into a named list of integer vectors of kept positions
    positions_by_chr <- split(pos_vals, chr_vals)
    # For each chromosome fill Coordinates_to_remove as setdiff(allpos, mapped_positions)
    for (chr in names(chr_length)){
      L <- as.integer(chr_length[[chr]])
      if (is.na(L) || L <= 0){
        warning("Invalid length for chromosome: ", chr); Coordinates_to_remove[[chr]] <- integer(0); next
      }
      mapped_pos <- integer(0)
      # try to match chromosome keys robustly: exact match, or without 'chr' prefix
      if (!is.null(positions_by_chr[[chr]])) mapped_pos <- positions_by_chr[[chr]]
      chr_no_chr <- sub("^chr", "", chr, ignore.case = TRUE)
      if (length(mapped_pos) == 0 && !is.null(positions_by_chr[[chr_no_chr]])) mapped_pos <- positions_by_chr[[chr_no_chr]]
      if (length(mapped_pos) == 0){
        Coordinates_to_remove[[chr]] <- seq_len(L)  # if none mapped, everything removed
        message("Chr ", chr, ": no mapped starts found in single file; mark all positions to remove")
        next
      }
      # sanitize mapped_pos: keep integers in 1..L
      mapped_pos <- unique(mapped_pos[!is.na(mapped_pos) & mapped_pos >= 1 & mapped_pos <= L])
      if (length(mapped_pos) == 0) {
        Coordinates_to_remove[[chr]] <- seq_len(L)
        message("Chr ", chr, ": after sanitization no mapped starts; mark all positions to remove")
        next
      }
      # coordinates to remove = setdiff(all positions, mapped_positions)
      coords_to_remove <- setdiff(seq_len(L), mapped_pos)
      Coordinates_to_remove[[chr]] <- coords_to_remove
      message("Chr ", chr, ": keep ", length(mapped_pos), " mapped starts; remove ", length(coords_to_remove))
    }
  } 
  
  if (!is.null(out_file)){
    saveRDS(Coordinates_to_remove, out_file)
    message("Saved coordinates_to_remove to ", out_file)
  }
  return(Coordinates_to_remove)
}


```

#step 3 \## ---------------- Part 3: Define read-number windows from alignability filter coordinates --------------

```{r}
genome_fa <- "ref/reference/GCA_000001405.15_GRCh38_mus.GRCm39.fa"
ont_bed   <- "TIGER/ont_mappability.bed"

win_size  <- 10000
cov_thr   <- 2        # ONT mappability threshold
out_file  <- "ONT_TIGER_windows_GC.RData"

# =============================
# FUNCTIONS
# =============================

calc_gc_401 <- function(seq_chr) {
  s <- toupper(as.character(seq_chr))
  x <- strsplit(s, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]

  is_gc <- as.integer(x == "G" | x == "C")
  is_n  <- as.integer(x == "N")

  k <- rep.int(1L, 401)
  k[201] <- 0L

  gc_sum <- stats::filter(is_gc, k, sides = 2)
  n_sum  <- stats::filter(is_n,  k, sides = 2)

  gc_frac <- rep(NA_real_, length(is_gc))
  ok <- !is.na(gc_sum) & n_sum == 0
  gc_frac[ok] <- gc_sum[ok] / 400

  gc_frac
}

bin_gc <- function(gc_frac) {
  b <- floor(gc_frac * 400) + 1L
  b[b < 1 | b > 401] <- NA
  b
}

make_windows <- function(L, low_pos, win_size) {
  keep <- rep.int(TRUE, L)
  keep[low_pos] <- FALSE

  idx <- which(keep)
  nwin <- floor(length(idx) / win_size)

  list(
    starts = idx[seq.int(1, nwin * win_size, by = win_size)],
    ends   = idx[seq.int(win_size, nwin * win_size, by = win_size)]
  )
}

count_gc_bins <- function(gc_bins, win_starts, win_ends) {
  pos <- which(!is.na(gc_bins))
  w <- findInterval(pos, win_starts)
  ok <- w > 0 & pos <= win_ends[w]

  tab <- table(w[ok], gc_bins[pos[ok]])

  out <- matrix(0L, length(win_starts), 401)
  out[as.integer(rownames(tab)), as.integer(colnames(tab))] <- tab
  out
}

# =============================
# LOAD INPUTS
# =============================

message("Loading ONT mappability BED...")
mapp <- fread(ont_bed, col.names = c("chr", "start", "end", "cov"))
mapp[, start := start + 1]
mapp[, chr := sub("\\s+.*$", "", chr)]
low_map <- mapp[cov < cov_thr]

message("Loading reference genome...")
fasta <- readDNAStringSet(genome_fa)
names(fasta) <- sub("\\s+.*$", "", names(fasta))

# intersect chromosomes
chroms <- intersect(names(fasta), unique(low_map$chr))
message("Processing chromosomes: ", paste(chroms, collapse = ", "))

# =============================
# MAIN LOOP
# =============================

Wins <- list()
Reads_expected_nominal <- list()

for (chr in chroms) {
  message("Processing ", chr)

  seq_chr <- fasta[[chr]]
  L <- length(seq_chr)

  low_pos <- unlist(
    Map(seq,
        low_map[chr == chr]$start,
        low_map[chr == chr]$end),
    use.names = FALSE
  )
  low_pos <- low_pos[low_pos >= 1 & low_pos <= L]

  wins <- make_windows(L, low_pos, win_size)

  Wins[[chr]] <- data.frame(
    chr = chr,
    start = wins$starts,
    end = wins$ends,
    center = round((wins$starts + wins$ends) / 2)
  )

  gc_frac <- calc_gc_401(seq_chr)
  gc_frac[low_pos] <- NA

  gc_bins <- bin_gc(gc_frac)

  Reads_expected_nominal[[chr]] <-
    count_gc_bins(gc_bins, wins$starts, wins$ends)

  gc()
}


# -----------------------------
# Save results
# -----------------------------
save(Wins, Reads_expected_nominal, file="ONT_TIGER_windows_GC.RData")
```

# step 4 ---------------- Part 4: Compute GC content in 401 bp windows and binning -------------------------

```{r}
# Dependencies:
# BiocManager::install(c("Rsamtools","Biostrings"))
# install.packages("data.table")
library(Rsamtools)
library(Biostrings)
library(data.table)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(IRanges)

compute_GC_bins_401_streamed <- function(ref_fasta,
                                         out_dir = ".",
                                         chunk_bp = 1e6,
                                         nbins = 401,
                                         exclude_center = TRUE,
                                         tmp_subdir = "gc_tmp",
                                         Coordinates_to_remove = NULL,
                                         flush_every = 5000,
                                         suppress_depr_warning = FALSE){
  # Memory-efficient GC-bin builder that EXCLUDES coordinates in Coordinates_to_remove.
  # If you cannot update Bioconductor, set suppress_depr_warning=TRUE to hide the internal deprecation warning.
  dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  tmpdir <- file.path(out_dir, tmp_subdir); dir.create(tmpdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  fai <- FaFile(ref_fasta)
  open.FaFile(fai)
  # Optionally suppress internal deprecation warnings from S4Vectors while calling seqinfo()
  if (suppress_depr_warning) {
    seqinfo_all <- suppressWarnings(seqinfo(fai))
  } else {
    seqinfo_all <- seqinfo(fai)
  }

  seqnames_full <- names(seqinfo_all)
  # Short name cleaning: keep first token and ensure 'chr' prefix
  seqnames_short <- sub("\\s+.*$", "", seqnames_full)
  seqnames_short <- ifelse(grepl("^chr", seqnames_short, ignore.case = TRUE),
                           sub("^(?i)chr", "chr", seqnames_short, perl = TRUE),
                           paste0("chr", seqnames_short))
  names(seqinfo_all) <- seqnames_short
  seqnames_ref_all <- names(seqinfo_all)
  seqlens <- seqlengths(seqinfo_all)

  # normalize Coordinates_to_remove keys if provided
  if (!is.null(Coordinates_to_remove)){
    if (!is.list(Coordinates_to_remove)) stop("Coordinates_to_remove must be a list named by chromosome.")
    norm_names <- function(x){
      x <- sub("\\s+.*$", "", x)
      ifelse(grepl("^chr", x, ignore.case = TRUE), sub("^(?i)chr", "chr", x, perl = TRUE), paste0("chr", x))
    }
    names(Coordinates_to_remove) <- norm_names(names(Coordinates_to_remove))
  }

  window_radius <- 200L
  window_len <- 2L * window_radius + 1L
  denom <- if (exclude_center) window_len - 1L else window_len

  map_to_bin <- function(frac){
    # clamp, handle NA
    frac_cl <- frac
    frac_cl[is.na(frac_cl)] <- NA_real_
    frac_cl[frac_cl < 0] <- 0
    frac_cl[frac_cl > 1] <- 1
    bidx <- round(frac_cl * (nbins - 1)) + 1L
    bidx[is.na(frac_cl)] <- NA_integer_
    # Ensure integer vector
    return(as.integer(bidx))
  }

  # iterate chromosomes (cleaned names)
  for (chr in seqnames_ref_all){
    message("Processing ", chr)
    L <- seqlens[[chr]]
    if (is.na(L) || L <= window_len){ message("  too short or missing; skipping"); next }

    # prepare per-bin temp files for this chr
    chr_tmp_dir <- file.path(tmpdir, paste0("tmp_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "_", chr)))
    if (!dir.exists(chr_tmp_dir)) dir.create(chr_tmp_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    bin_paths <- file.path(chr_tmp_dir, paste0("bin_", seq_len(nbins), ".txt"))
    # ensure no stale files
    lapply(bin_paths, function(p) if (file.exists(p)) file.remove(p))

    # prepare sorted removal vector for fast membership checks
    removed_vec <- integer(0)
    if (!is.null(Coordinates_to_remove) && !is.null(Coordinates_to_remove[[chr]])){
      removed_vec <- sort(unique(as.integer(Coordinates_to_remove[[chr]])))
      removed_vec <- removed_vec[!is.na(removed_vec) & removed_vec >= 1 & removed_vec <= L]
    }

    centers_min <- window_radius + 1L
    centers_max <- L - window_radius
    if (centers_min > centers_max) { message("  no valid centers, skipping"); next }
    chunk_starts <- seq(centers_min, centers_max, by = as.integer(chunk_bp))

    # in-memory buffers per bin (flush to disk periodically)
    buffers <- vector("list", nbins)
    buf_sizes <- integer(nbins)

    # sanity checks
    if (!is.list(buffers) || length(buffers) != nbins) stop("Internal error: buffers not of length nbins")
    if (length(bin_paths) != nbins) stop("Internal error: bin_paths length mismatch nbins")

    for (cstart in chunk_starts){
      cend <- min(centers_max, cstart + as.integer(chunk_bp) - 1L)
      fetch_start <- max(1L, cstart - window_radius)
      fetch_end <- min(L, cend + window_radius)

      # fetch sequence for the chunk
      rng <- GRanges(seqnames = chr, ranges = IRanges(start = fetch_start, end = fetch_end))
      seq_chunk <- scanFa(fai, rng)[[1]]
      s <- as.character(seq_chunk)
      chars <- strsplit(s, split = "")[[1]]
      # fast numeric vectors
      isGC <- as.integer(chars == "G" | chars == "C")
      isN  <- as.integer(chars == "N" | chars == "n")
      Gcum <- cumsum(isGC)
      Ncum <- cumsum(isN)

      centers <- seq(cstart, cend)
      ncenters <- length(centers)
      win_start <- centers - window_radius; win_end <- centers + window_radius
      local_ws <- win_start - fetch_start + 1L; local_we <- win_end - fetch_start + 1L

      # use cumulative sums to compute counts
      leftG <- c(0L, Gcum); gc_counts <- Gcum[local_we] - leftG[local_ws]
      leftN <- c(0L, Ncum); n_counts  <- Ncum[local_we] - leftN[local_ws]

      if (exclude_center){
        center_local_idx <- centers - fetch_start + 1L
        center_isGC <- isGC[center_local_idx]
        gc_exc <- gc_counts - center_isGC
        nonN_exc <- (window_len - n_counts) - 1L
        ok_idx <- which(nonN_exc == denom)
        gc_frac <- rep(NA_real_, ncenters)
        if (length(ok_idx) > 0) gc_frac[ok_idx] <- gc_exc[ok_idx] / denom
      } else {
        nonN_counts <- window_len - n_counts
        ok_idx <- which(nonN_counts == denom)
        gc_frac <- rep(NA_real_, ncenters)
        if (length(ok_idx) > 0) gc_frac[ok_idx] <- gc_counts[ok_idx] / denom
      }

      # map to bins
      bin_idx <- map_to_bin(gc_frac)
      # TEMP diagnostic: put this right after bin_idx <- map_to_bin(gc_frac)
bad_idx_all <- which(!is.na(bin_idx) & (bin_idx < 1 | bin_idx > nbins))
if (length(bad_idx_all) > 0) {
  dbg_file <- file.path(out_dir, "gc_bin_debug.log")
  cat("=== BAD BIN INDICES DETECTED ===\n", file = dbg_file, append = TRUE)
  cat("chr:", chr, "chunk:", cstart, "-", cend, "\n", file = dbg_file, append = TRUE)
  cat("unique(bin_idx):", paste(unique(bin_idx, na.rm = TRUE), collapse = ","), "\n", file = dbg_file, append = TRUE)
  cat("bad positions (first 20):\n", file = dbg_file, append = TRUE)
  print_df <- data.frame(center = centers[bad_idx_all],
                         gc_frac = gc_frac[bad_idx_all],
                         bin_idx = bin_idx[bad_idx_all])[1:min(length(bad_idx_all),20), ]
  write.table(print_df, file = dbg_file, append = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
  stop("Bad bin indices detected — see ", dbg_file)
}

      valid_idx <- which(!is.na(bin_idx))
      if (length(valid_idx) == 0) { 
        # nothing to do this chunk
        rm(seq_chunk, s, chars, isGC, isN, Gcum, Ncum, gc_counts, n_counts, gc_frac, bin_idx); gc(); next 
      }

      # exclude removed coordinates (fast findInterval)
      if (length(removed_vec) > 0){
        fi <- findInterval(centers[valid_idx], removed_vec)
        present <- fi > 0 & removed_vec[fi] == centers[valid_idx]
        keep_local_mask <- !present
        if (!any(keep_local_mask)) {
          rm(seq_chunk, s, chars, isGC, isN, Gcum, Ncum, gc_counts, n_counts, gc_frac, bin_idx); gc(); next
        }
        keep_idx <- valid_idx[keep_local_mask]
      } else {
        keep_idx <- valid_idx
      }
      
      # --- SAFE APPEND & DIAGNOSTIC: replace existing append code with this ---
# Assumes variables available: bin_idx, keep_idx, centers, buffers, buf_sizes, buf_paths, buf_sizes, flush_every, nbins, bin_paths, out_dir

# file to log bad bins
bad_log <- file.path(out_dir, "bad_bin_indices.log")

if (length(keep_idx) > 0) {
  # compute the bin numbers for kept indices
  bins_kept <- bin_idx[keep_idx]

  # ensure bins_kept is integer-like
  if (!is.integer(bins_kept)) bins_kept <- as.integer(bins_kept)

  # detect invalid bin indices
  invalid_mask <- is.na(bins_kept) | bins_kept < 1L | bins_kept > nbins
  if (any(invalid_mask)) {
    # log detailed diagnostic about the first few invalid cases
    bad_vals <- unique(bins_kept[invalid_mask])
    msg <- paste0(Sys.time(), " - Warning: ", sum(invalid_mask), " invalid bin indices found. examples: ",
                  paste(head(bad_vals, 10), collapse = ", "), 
                  " (nbins=", nbins, ").\n")
    cat(msg, file = bad_log, append = TRUE)
    # optionally print to console for immediate feedback
    message(msg)
    # filter them out so we don't try to index buffers with them
    keep_idx <- keep_idx[!invalid_mask]
    bins_kept <- bins_kept[!invalid_mask]
  }

  if (length(keep_idx) > 0) {

  bins_kept <- as.integer(bin_idx[keep_idx])

  # STRICT validation
  valid_mask <- !is.na(bins_kept) & bins_kept >= 1L & bins_kept <= nbins
  if (!any(valid_mask)) next

  bins_kept <- bins_kept[valid_mask]
  keep_idx  <- keep_idx[valid_mask]

  # iterate by index, not value
  ub <- sort(unique(bins_kept))

  for (i in seq_along(ub)) {
    bi <- ub[[i]]  # guaranteed scalar integer

    # FINAL defensive check
    if (bi < 1L || bi > nbins) next

    idxs_local <- keep_idx[bins_kept == bi]
    if (length(idxs_local) == 0) next

    vals <- centers[idxs_local]

    buffers[[bi]] <- c(buffers[[bi]], vals)
    buf_sizes[bi] <- length(buffers[[bi]])

    if (buf_sizes[bi] >= flush_every) {
      data.table::fwrite(
        data.table::data.table(pos = buffers[[bi]]),
        file = bin_paths[bi],
        append = TRUE,
        col.names = F
      )
      buffers[[bi]] <- integer(0)
      buf_sizes[bi] <- 0L
    }
  }
}
}

      # cleanup chunk-level variables and free memory
      rm(seq_chunk, s, chars, isGC, isN, Gcum, Ncum, gc_counts, n_counts, gc_frac, bin_idx)
      gc()
    } # end chunk loop

    # flush remaining buffers to disk
   for (bi in seq_len(nbins)){
  if (length(buffers[[bi]]) > 0){
    data.table::fwrite(
      data.table::data.table(pos = buffers[[bi]]),
      file = bin_paths[bi],
      append = TRUE,
      col.names = F
    )
    buffers[[bi]] <- integer(0)  # ✅ SAFE
    buf_sizes[bi] <- 0L
  }
}


    # assemble final bin list (read per-bin files)
    bin_list <- vector("list", nbins)
    for (bi in seq_len(nbins)){
      p <- bin_paths[bi]
      if (file.exists(p)){
        v <- scan(p, what = integer(), quiet = TRUE)
        bin_list[[bi]] <- if (length(v) == 0) integer(0) else v
        file.remove(p)
      } else {
        bin_list[[bi]] <- integer(0)
      }
    }
    unlink(chr_tmp_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
    safe_chr <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_\\-]", "_", chr)
    out_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("GC_cont_401_bins_chr", safe_chr, ".rds"))
    saveRDS(bin_list, out_path)
    message("  saved ", out_path)
    # keep memory low by not storing bin_list beyond this point
    rm(bin_list); gc()
  } # end chromosome loop

  close.FaFile(fai)
  message("Done. GC bins written to: ", normalizePath(out_dir))
  invisible(NULL)
}
```
